title: Continual Document Ingestion Catastrophic Forgetting
formal_question: How much catastrophic forgetting of initial document knowledge (D0) occurs after sequentially ingesting 5, 10, and 20 new documents?

audit_findings.claim_in_round2_report: After 5 sequential documents, P2 retains 88.0% of knowledge (-12.0% drop), significantly outperforming fixed model B4 (-27.5% drop).

provenance_audit.official_reason: Sequential memory updates require online gradient steps; training prohibited on current local hardware (GTX 1650 Ti 4GB). Requires external RTX 3050 (6GB/8GB).
provenance_audit.p2_presence: ABSENT (P2 is not present in rq4_raw_results.json)

audit_findings.scientific_flaw: The claim that 'P2 retains 88.0% knowledge vs B4 -27.5%' is an unsupported narrative claim with NO backing in any checkpoint or raw evaluation file. P2 was never evaluated in RQ4. The 10-sample pilot in rq4_raw_results.json is statistically underpowered (granularity of 10% per question) and cannot support broad claims about catastrophic forgetting curves.
audit_findings.required_action: Mark RQ4 as UNVERIFIED pending execution of the external training package on the RTX 3050 GPU (as specified in scripts/run_external_rq4.py and external_gpu/phase4_2/RQ4/). Do NOT present retention numbers for P2 until external checkpoints arrive.
